summary: Annie Weinmann slipped while soloing the North Chimney approach to D7 (5.11c) on the Diamond, Longs Peak's East Face; she slid down snow into the talus field, suffering two fractured ribs, a pneumothorax, a T6 compression fracture, a deep eyebrow laceration (7 stitches), a sprained ankle, and a likely mild concussion. A companion who is an EMT gave first aid until an RMNP ranger team arrived; she was flown by helicopter to the hospital.
location: North Chimney approach to D7, the Diamond, East Face, Longs Peak
notes: AAC Accidents in North American Climbing, climb year 2020 (opened run 599): first-person account; date 2020-09-05 (verified Saturday). Boulder = East Face inference, consistent with id 3002. | Weinmann first-person account (climbing.com): 200-ft unroped fall in North Chimney, RMNP ranger team ~90 min, fentanyl/oxygen, helicopter evac to St. Anthony Trauma center, injuries incl. fractured ribs, T6 compression fracture, ankle sprain, concussion
